description: GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity. At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today! Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg. As the Senior Product Manager in GovTech, you will assist the Project Director and work with the product team to revamp the whole of government (WOG) finance and accounting system and to drive innovative digital product throughout their life cycles, so that government agencies can successfully deliver their digital agenda. Product Managers make sure that the right things get done so that our digital products meet user needs and continuously remain relevant. At a high level, this means establishing a clear vision for what a product should be and what is needed to get there. On a day-to-day basis, this means handling all the different facets of a product and making sure they are coordinated – across user needs, technical constraints, and design goals. Success in the role will be proven by your ability to thrive in a dynamic and multifaceted environment, while keeping yourself up to date on new technology developments. What you will be working on You are a hands-on Senior Product Manager and will be involved in planning and executing the full product lifecycle including the following: 1. Crafting Customer Experiences for Each User Journey • Engage the agency Product Owner to establish a clear vision for what the product should be and what is needed to get there • Collaborate with business partners to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, as well as obtain key stakeholder buy-in • Work out the product outreach and promotion strategies with business partners • Define the product go-to-market strategy and work with relevant partners to execute the plan 2. Designing, Testing, and Iterating Through Experiments • Design, test, and iterate through experiments to improve the user journey • Execute hands-on system configuration when required, including developing proof-of-concept (POC) to validate new features • Manage the product budget through expenditure monitoring, cashflow management, and securing funding • Develop the workplan and ensure successful delivery by the product team / external vendors • Provide sufficient resources for product development, including procurement of software, hardware, and ICT professional services 3. Monitoring, Capturing, and Studying User Behaviour • Conduct user studies to understand their needs and problems • Analyse data to uncover usage patterns that can inform product decisions • Research the industry to understand complimentary and competing solutions 4. Collecting, Analyzing, and Presenting User Interest • Translate the product strategy into technical, detailed, actionable plans for business and vendor teams • Understand the developers’ needs and if necessary support them in exploring emerging tools and techniques that can meet their needs 5. Analysing and Studying User Segments • Formulate strong proposals by evaluating the pros and cons of different solutions and provide compelling justifications for them • Consider how the services could be delivered for different market segments and prioritize feature development 6. Creating Data-Driven Analytics and Insights • Create data-driven analytics and insights for action and to make appropriate trade-offs • Coordinate efforts across multiple functions including marketing, legal, and finance • Co-create with the Product Owner to draft the budget papers to seek resources for the product's development 7. Driving User Growth • Drive user adoption and growth through increased engagement, expanding types of features, and higher usage in a financially sustainable manner • Maintain a wide network with key user agencies and central government product teams to seek opportunities for product collaborations • Participate in public-speaking engagements to raise awareness of the product and gain more users 8. Keeping Things Organized • Run efficient meetings to keep stakeholders and product team members updated • Prioritize, plan, and track what needs to be done • Document key information and decisions about the product • Be responsible for securing funding and monitoring expenses 9. Compliance and Governance • Ensure that Product meets security and performance requirements (SSAT, VAPT, Performance Testing) • Adhere to compliance requirements and audits (IM, AGO, QMS, etc.) What we are looking for Degree in Computer Science or Infocomm Technology or Electronics Engineering or related discipline with a minimum 5 years of relevant ICT experience. Working directly with engineers, designers and other product managers (ideally at least 3 years). Strong analytical, conceptualisation and problem-solving skills Good communication skills with the ability to pitch ideas and influence A driven and motivated personality with an inquisitive mind Ability to learn and apply Relevant certifications such as CITPM, COMIT, PMP, and Certified Scrum Master.
